## AdminLimitsApi

Source: `BusinessTestCases/pageElements/Shared/AdminLimitsApi.ts`

About: Admin Portal → Manage Limits (Wallet Balance / Transaction / Count), driven API-first.  Endpoints read off the live dev admin SPA (2026-10-13, limitations-management module bundle):   GET\|PUT {GATEWAY}/api/v1/limitations/admin-wallet-limitations   GET\|PUT {GATEWAY}/api/v1/limitations/transaction-limitations        (min amount + HOUR/DAY/MONTH/YEAR max amount)   GET\|PUT {GATEWAY}/api/v1/limitations/transaction-count-limitations  (HOUR/DAY/MONTH/YEAR max count) The write is the SAME URL as the read, method PUT. Lookups: /api/v1/transaction-types, /risk-levels, /platform-type, /wallet-types.  Findings that differ from the first draft of Topup-Admin-Config-Matrix.md:   - The minimum top-up amount is NOT a separate setting: it is the `min` field of the Transaction limit row     (type × risk level × platform), written together with the four period maxima.   - Periods are HOUR / DAY / MONTH / YEAR (no WEEK). There is no separate per-transaction max (TXN_MAX).   - Risk level and Platform offer an "ALL" choice that the SPA guards with a warning modal — never use it here.  UNVERIFIED (no write was ever sent while capturing): the exact GET paging params and response envelope, and the PUT body field names are taken from the SPA's own form controls (`riskLevel`, `platformTypeCode`, `transactionTypeCodes`, `transactionCategoryCodes`, `hourly\|daily\|monthly\|yearlyPeriodAmount`, `min`, `…PeriodTransactionCount`, `walletType`, `minBalance`, `maxBalance`, `isActive`). The first real run should confirm them; every method throws with the raw response on a non-2xx so a mismatch is obvious.  Auth: relays the headers of a real request the admin SPA sent (same approach and reasons as AdminCommissionManagementPage.ensureApiHeaders — `device-finger-print` embeds the token). One admin login at a time: a second login invalidates the first (401 SESSION_INVALID).  Top-up transaction types as named by the admin "Cash-In" group. Code 102003 is confirmed (TopupHelper); resolve the rest by name. */ One GET row of the Transaction limits grid — one per type × risk × platform × period. */ What one PUT writes for a type × risk × platform cell: the minimum plus all four period maxima. */ Everything needed to put one cell back exactly as found. */

Routes/paths: `LIMITS_PATH = /api/v1/limitations/admin-wallet-limitations`, `WALLET_LIMITS_URL = ${ADMIN_BASE_URL}/admin/main/limitations-management/wallet-limitations`

## AdminOtpConfigPage

Source: `BusinessTestCases/pageElements/Shared/AdminOtpConfigPage.ts`

About: Admin Portal → System Configurations → OTP  ("OTP Configuration" screen).  This is the *admin* SPA (`/admin/...`), a different app from the merchant `/business/...` portal every other page object here targets, so it carries its own login rather than reusing `session.json` / `LoginPage`. Credentials default to the shared dev admin account and are overridable via env vars.  Used by both Login/ and Registration/ to assert that the OTP *operation* assignment for LOGIN / registration is locked on in the default OTP setting (the checkbox is checked and disabled — the platform mandates OTP on those flows and an admin cannot detach them from a setting). Hence Shared/.  Locators are page-authored `id`s read off the live dev DOM (2026-09-09) — the admin portal is not in QA-DATA-TESTID-HANDOFF.md. Key anchors:   #otp-configurations-list-row-options-button   per-row ⋮ menu   #otp-configurations-list-row-option-edit-operation   "Edit Operations" item   #operations-modal-container                    the "All Operations" modal   #input_type_text_name_standalone_<CODE>        per-operation name field   #operations-modal-operation-checkbox-<n>       per-operation checkbox A locked (assigned + non-detachable) checkbox also carries `.disabled-checkbox`.  The admin SPA is hosted separately from the merchant portal. Confirmed live 2026-09-22: this admin account now goes through a 6-box OTP step after Login is clicked (it previously didn't — see login()'s comment). Same dev-environment all-zeros bypass CLAUDE.md documents for the merchant login's 8-digit OTP, confirmed separately for Topup's 6-digit transaction OTP (TopupNegative.spec.ts) — this is the 6-digit form of the same bypass. OTP operation codes as they appear in the name field id suffix. */ Riyadh — matches playwright.config.ts's geolocation. The admin SPA throws a blocking `app-permission-overlay` over the whole page (login form included) until location is granted, so a bare `browser.newPage()` — which does NOT inherit the config's `use` permissions — can never fill the form.  A context set up the way the admin SPA needs: geolocation granted for the dev origin so its permission overlay never mounts. Use this in a spec's `beforeAll` instead of `browser.newPage()`.

Routes/paths: `BASE_URL = BASE_URL`, `ADMIN_BASE_URL = ADMIN_BASE_URL`, `ADMIN_LOGIN_URL = ${ADMIN_BASE_URL}/admin/auth/login`, `ADMIN_OTP_CONFIG_URL = ${ADMIN_BASE_URL}/admin/main/configuration/otp`
